activity_summary: At evening prayer Master Thwaite would not preach the morning's sermon again. The glass had been once. He said the cloud only to refuse a second time. He did not come in to supper. You did not ask him for a longer hour.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Accepted the refusal and did not ask for the cloud again.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Kept the morning's sermon to the morning, and did not come in.

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: The glass was once this morning.
